title: Why *confident idiots* win (and how you beat them)

label: STAGE 1
head: Watched 3 videos, feels like an expert
sub: Peak confidence, zero skill. Loudest guy in the room.

label: STAGE 2
head: Starts doing it, realizes he knows nothing

label: STAGE 3
head: Gets better and still doubts himself
sub: Real skill feels smaller from the inside.

label: STAGE 4
head: Quiet, calm, actually good
sub: Says "it depends" and is usually right.

text: Doubting yourself means you're past stage 1. *Keep going* and speak up anyway.
